title: M1 foundation decisions for distribution, initialization and lifecycle
goal: Record accepted D01-D10 decisions that unblock exact M1 implementation Plans without authorizing implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: V4-AD-036 records self-contained .NET product runtimes with declared external Module prerequisites and rejects a fully bundled zero-prerequisite distribution.
V4-AD-037 records OS-specific Init defaults and overrides, explicit four-root Host invocation, Target-owned .guard governance and historical adoption separation.
V4-AD-038 records operator-supplied sibling version lifecycle plus bounded, protected and receipted cleanup and retention behavior.
V4-TODO-007, V4-TODO-010 and V4-TODO-019 distinguish accepted decisions from implementation that remains open.
No product code, contract, test, workflow, ruleset, package, consumer repository or remote state changes occur.
risks: A documentation decision could be mistaken for implementation authorization.
Provisional retention limits could be mistaken for stable compatibility promises before measurement.
decisions: D01 accepts self-contained .NET Host and Companion distributions while keeping Module-specific runtimes external.
D02 accepts OS-derived per-user StateRoot and EvidenceRoot defaults with Init preview and validated overrides.
D03 through D07 accept .guard active governance, separate adoption history, classified receipts, deferred external governance and non-mutating Init.
D08 and D09 accept operator-supplied sibling updates, explicit selection and compatibility-gated downgrade.
D10 accepts protected references, automatic successful-work cleanup, bounded retention, measured capacity defaults and receipted safe deletion.
